_comment: Governance settings as code (#508). Desired state for a NEW tag ruleset. Release tags (v*) trigger docker-publish.yml, so they are a higher-value target than the branch: once created they must be immutable. `creation` is deliberately NOT restricted here -- release.yml (via the release GitHub App) creates them -- but `update`, `deletion`, and `non_fast_forward` block anyone from moving or removing a published release tag. Apply with: gh api --method POST /repos/DrewBrunning/mycorrhizal-crm/rulesets --input .github/rulesets/tags-v.json (this ruleset does not exist yet). governance-drift.yml will track it once applied. bypass_actors: the release GitHub App only, so an emergency retag is possible through the one-dispatch release path and nothing else.
name: v-tag-protection
